1 | PASS | `src/app/(auth)/register/page.tsx` implements user registration with Supabase Auth and profile creation.
2 | PASS | `src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` implements user login with Supabase Auth and session management.
3 | PASS | `src/components/Navbar.tsx` implements user logout functionality via `supabase.auth.signOut()`.
4 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines durable tables for users, listings, bookings, and payments with RLS.
5 | PASS | `src/app/search/page.tsx` and `src/components/ListingCard.tsx` provide a structured browsing interface.
6 | FAIL | `src/app/search/page.tsx` implements location filtering but lacks server-side logic for date, price, and property type filters.
7 | PASS | `src/app/list/[id]/page.tsx` displays detailed property pages with descriptions, amenities, and host info.
8 | PASS | `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` includes date pickers, guest count selection, and price calculation logic.
9 | PASS | `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` inserts booking data into the database upon successful payment.
10 | PASS | `src/app/list/new/page.tsx` provides a multi-step form for hosts to post new rental properties.
11 | FAIL | `src/app/list/new/page.tsx` allows creation but no UI or API routes exist for editing, archiving, or deleting existing listings.
12 | PASS | `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` displays guest bookings and host listings, fulfilling the dashboard requirement.
13 | FAIL | No real-time availability updates or double-booking prevention logic (e.g., database constraints or subscriptions) are implemented.
14 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` ensures durable persistence of bookings and metadata with appropriate constraints and triggers.
15 | PASS | `src/lib/stripe.ts` and `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` integrate Stripe for payment processing.
16 | FAIL | `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` calls a missing `/api/payments/create-intent` route; the API route file is not provided.
17 | FAIL | `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` updates booking status but does not create or update payment records in the `payments` table.
18 | FAIL | `src/app/dashboard/page.tsx` does not query or display payment transaction details or statuses to the user.
19 | FAIL | `src/app/list/[id]/BookingForm.tsx` shows generic errors but lacks specific UI for retrying or switching payment methods.
20 | PASS | `src/app/list/new/page.tsx` allows uploading multiple photos via `handleFileUpload` and stores them in Supabase Storage.
21 | PASS | `src/app/list/new/page.tsx` includes a file input for videos and stores them in the `listing_media` table.
22 | FAIL | `src/app/list/new/page.tsx` allows adding/removing media but lacks UI controls for previewing (beyond basic img) or reordering.
23 | PASS | `src/components/ListingGallery.tsx` displays photos in a carousel with navigation controls on the detail page.
24 | FAIL | `src/components/ListingGallery.tsx` only shows a "Watch video" button; it does not embed or play the video on the detail page.

rubric.4: Application stores all users, listings, bookings, and associated metadata in a durable database.
rubric.5: Application allows users to browse available properties in a structured, visually clear interface.
rubric.6: Application provides property search with filters for location, dates, price, and property type.
rubric.7: Application displays detailed property pages that include descriptions and essential listing information.
rubric.8: Application implements a booking flow that includes a date picker, guest count selection, and accurate price calculation.
rubric.9: Application allows users to book a property and ensures all booking data is stored in the database.
rubric.10: Application allows users to post new rental properties for others to book.
rubric.11: Application provides full listing management, including the ability to edit, archive, and delete properties.
rubric.12: Application provides each user with a dashboard that displays their trip history and their hosting activity.
rubric.13: Application delivers real-time availability updates to ensure that no property can be double-booked.
rubric.14: Application persists all bookings and listing metadata in the database in a durable and consistent manner.
rubric.15: Application integrates with a secure modern payment provider to process end-to-end payments.
rubric.16: Application captures payment details during the booking flow and charges the guest upon booking confirmation or according to the selected payment model.
rubric.17: Application records all payment transactions in the database with statuses such as pending, succeeded, failed, or refunded.
rubric.18: Application provides user-facing views that display payment-related information such as total cost and payment status.
rubric.19: Application handles payment errors gracefully by surfacing clear messages and allowing users to retry or switch payment methods.
rubric.20: Application allows hosts to upload multiple photos for each listing as part of the creation and editing flow.
rubric.21: Application allows hosts to upload at least one video for each listing.
rubric.22: Application provides clear UI controls for adding, previewing, reordering, and removing uploaded photos and videos.
rubric.23: Application displays uploaded photos prominently on the property detail page using a gallery or carousel.
rubric.24: Application displays uploaded videos prominently on the property detail page using an embedded video player.
